Altshuler Shaham Ltd Boosts Position in Oracle Corporation $ORCL

Altshuler Shaham Ltd raised its holdings in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL – Free Report) by 0.5% in the 1st quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the SEC. The firm owned 1,324,210 shares of the enterprise software provider’s stock after acquiring an additional 6,927 shares
